/about.title: About | Explore with Purpose — Start Your Journey — Vandra

blocks.P.sqsrte-small: Vandra™ takes its name from the Swedish word vandra, meaning “to hike” or “to wander.” This simple yet powerful word reflects our core belief that exploring the outdoors is a vital part of a balanced life.

blocks.P: At Vandra™, we honor these Scandinavian ideals through minimalist design, sustainable materials, and thoughtful functionality—ensuring our products support you on every journey. Whether you’re an avid hiker exploring new trails or simply looking to bring a bit of Nordic calm to your daily life, we invite you to embrace the essence of vandra and discover your own path forward.

At Vandra™, we envision a world where everyone discovers the simple joy of wandering in nature. Guided by Scandinavian values of sustainability, minimalism, and respect for the outdoors, our goal is to inspire a global community that embraces exploration, nurtures the environment, and brings a sense of calm to everyday life—no matter where the path leads.

blocks.H2: Whether you’re an avid hiker exploring new trails or simply looking to bring a bit of Nordic calm to your daily life, we invite you to embrace the essence of vandra and discover your own path forward.

blocks.P.sqsrte-small: Born in the heart of Scandinavia, our ethos is shaped by the region’s long-standing traditions of enjoying nature in all its forms—like Norway’s “tura” culture of everyday adventures, Finland’s spirit of overcoming the rugged outdoors, and Sweden’s love for camping and fishing in pristine forests and lakes. These customs have taught us that stepping outside, even for a short wander, can bring clarity, joy, and a sense of connection to the world around us.

blocks.alt: Snow-covered mountain with a conical shape under a cloudy sky.

blocks.H2: "From remote trails to everyday routines, Vandra offers a way to carry balance with you. It’s about finding clarity in movement, and calm in the moments between."

blocks.P.sqsrte-small: Metin AgarCEO & Founder

/stories/iceland.title: Iceland: 'Hiking Europe’s biggest active volcano' — Vandra

blocks.P: DateOctober 2024
EquipmentVandra™ Glacier
Story submitted by @Metin Agar

blocks.H2: Crossing Fire & Ice A Journey Through Iceland with Vandra

blocks.H4: A path less pavedIn early spring, Ali and Metin set out on a trek across southern Iceland — a place where terrain shifts from lava fields to glacial plains in a single afternoon. Their goal: to reach the edges of Vatnajökull, Europe’s largest glacier, carrying Metins 1-year-old daughter with them. What they found was not just a landscape shaped by fire and ice, but a kind of calm in the chaos. A stillness that made the wind and snow feel like old companions.

Built for the wild, shaped for lifeCrossing glacial tongues and tracing ancient volcanic ridges, they discovered something unexpected: that the more remote the terrain, the more connected they felt. "It was never about conquering the landscape," Metin added. "It was about moving through it together." From Reykjavik to Skaftafell and beyond, their journey wasn’t just about the destination — it was a story written one step at a time. Vandra came with them, but more importantly, helped keep the adventure theirs.

Moving through contrastsThe trip was as unpredictable as Iceland itself. One moment under blue skies, the next in sideways rain. What remained constant was their pace — and their gear. The Vandra™ Glacier kept their equipment protected through each shift, with its weatherproof outer, ergonomic frame, and modular compartments allowing them to adjust on the go.

blocks.H2: Crossing Fire & Ice A Journey Through Iceland with Vandra

blocks.H4: A path less pavedIn early spring, Ali and Metin set out on a trek across southern Iceland — a place where terrain shifts from lava fields to glacial plains in a single afternoon. Their goal: to reach the edges of Vatnajökull, Europe’s largest glacier, carrying Metins 1-year-old daughter with them. What they found was not just a landscape shaped by fire and ice, but a kind of calm in the chaos. A stillness that made the wind and snow feel like old companions.

Built for the wild, shaped for lifeCrossing glacial tongues and tracing ancient volcanic ridges, they discovered something unexpected: that the more remote the terrain, the more connected they felt. "It was never about conquering the landscape," Metin added. "It was about moving through it together." From Reykjavik to Skaftafell and beyond, their journey wasn’t just about the destination — it was a story written one step at a time. Vandra came with them, but more importantly, helped keep the adventure theirs.

Moving through contrastsThe trip was as unpredictable as Iceland itself. One moment under blue skies, the next in sideways rain. What remained constant was their pace — and their gear. The Vandra™ Glacier kept their equipment protected through each shift, with its weatherproof outer, ergonomic frame, and modular compartments allowing them to adjust on the go.

blocks.H2: Hiking the Norwegian Fjell A Journey in Norw with Vandra™

blocks.H4: Into the highlandsIn early summer, Djani and Melissa set off with their daughter Bella on a trail through the Norwegian highlands. Starting in the Hemsedal valley, they moved between open plateaus and narrow birch forests, following the quiet pulse of the land. Their goal wasn’t a summit — it was the stillness between the climbs, the unspoken moments when Bella’s laughter echoed into the wide sky. What they found was not just space to walk, but space to be.

Less weight, more presenceCrossing shallow rivers and winding through highland moss, they carried only what they needed — and noticed more because of it. “We stopped thinking about what we were carrying,” Djani said. “It just worked.” The Vandra™ system moved with them, not against them: weatherproof, balanced, and adaptable as the terrain shifted. It didn’t just carry Bella. It kept the rhythm of the day.

When the light lingersOne moment brought sun over snow patches, the next a soft drizzle through clouded skies. But their pace never faltered. With modular compartments and a snug, weatherproof frame, Vandra™ kept Bella close, dry, and content. “We didn’t need to hurry,” Melissa said. “Everything we needed was already with us.” The journey wasn’t about reaching somewhere — it was about what stayed with them along the way.

Last Updated: June 2025

Vandra is a brand owned and operated by PFS Enterprise LLC. Your privacy is important to us. This policy explains how we collect, use, and protect your personal information when you interact with our brand, website, or support channels.
1. Information We Collect
We only collect personal information you voluntarily provide to us, such as:
• Contact details (e.g., name, email, phone number)
• Shipping information (e.g., address, country, zip code)
• Product registration details (e.g., model name, date code)
• Communications with customer support
We do not collect payment information directly.
2. How We Use Your Information
We use your information to:
• Provide customer support
• Register your product for safety alerts or recall notifications
• Respond to product-related questions or feedback
• Improve our products and customer experience
We do not sell, rent, or share your personal data with third parties for marketing purposes.
3. Data Security
We use reasonable physical, technical, and administrative safeguards to protect your information. Access is restricted to authorized personnel only.
4. Your Rights
You may request to:
• Access the personal information we have about you
• Correct or update your information
• Have your data deleted from our systems
• Opt out of further communication
To exercise these rights, contact us at info@vandrastudios.com.
5. Children’s Privacy
Our website and products are not directed to children under 13 years of age. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children.
6. Cookies and Tracking
We do not currently use cookies or tracking tools on our website. If this changes in the future, we will update this policy accordingly.
7. Changes to This Policy
We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. The latest version will always be posted on this page with a revised date.

For questions or concerns about your privacy, please contact:info@vandrastudios.com
